title: McGraw Hill, Inc. to Participate in an Investor Call Hosted by Goldman Sachs
summary: McGraw Hill , Inc. (NYSE: MH) today announced that Philip Moyer, President, Chief Executive Officer and member of the Board of Directors, will participate in a call hosted by George Tong, an equity research analyst with Goldman Sachs. The call will take place on Thursday, August 20, 2026, at 1:30 PM ET. The discussion will focus on AI as a growth vector for McGraw Hill and the company’s leadership role in agentic technology. For registration, please contact your Goldman Sachs representative or george.tong@gs.com .
